name: Untaxed Spice Parcel
description:
A sealed quarter-pound spice parcel lacks customs markings. Its contents are ordinary culinary spice, and local law determines the consequence.

Legality and provenance depend on the campaign. The GM confirms restrictions and any checks; this item grants no automatic access, immunity or bonus.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for the complete stated sale unit, including its wrapping or supplied vessel.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
